name: Dfrobot Sen0395 → Settings
description: The DFRobot mmWave Radar has several settings which can be changed. These settings are saved in non-volatile memory and do not need to be set on each boot.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the mmWave sensor on which settings should be changed. If only one radar is defined, this is optional.

config_entries.label: Detection Segments
config_entries.description: A list of detection segments. A segment specifies from where to where detection should trigger. One to four segments and ranges from 0cm to 9m may be specified. Distances should be defined in steps of 15cm. Note that the specified ranges are rounded internally. Segments can be defined in a one or two dimensional list. Pairs of values must be defined (from distance to distance). The default is one range from 0cm to 3m. **Examples**

config_entries.label: Factory Reset
config_entries.description: If set to `true`, a factory reset of the sensor will be performed (before changing other options if present). Ignored if not set or set to `false`.

config_entries.label: Output Latency
config_entries.description: Delays applied to the detection output.

config_entries.label: Delay After Detect
config_entries.description: Time to wait before signaling that a person was detected. Specify in steps of 25 ms. Factory default is 2.5s. Returning -1 keeps the value unchanged.

config_entries.label: Delay After Disappear
config_entries.description: Time to wait before signaling that a person is no longer detected. Specify in steps of 25 ms. Factory default is 10 s. Returning -1 keeps the value unchanged.

config_entries.label: Sensitivity
config_entries.description: Set the sensitivity of the sensor. Ranges from 0 to 9. Return 0-9. Returning -1 keeps the value unchanged.
